_: Every banked checkpoint's expected v2 STAMP, MEASURED — this file is written from the probe, never predicted. Unstamped rows carry the reason, because a gap that is written down is a gap and a gap that is silent is a bug. Since tensorfs#153 the -hub rows are the primary evidence: every lane pair in successors.json is proven by at least one banked checkpoint tensorhub actually publishes (digest-pinned) stamping exactly that pair. The @1-era sub-tree banks (sd15, sd-turbo, ernie, ltx-2-upsampler, sdxl-inpainting and its recast) now stamp NOTHING and are recorded as such — they remain banked because the v1-verdict regression replays against their exact content.

unstamped.ernie: same: ERNIE-Image's transformer subfolder alone (2 shards).
unstamped.ltx-2-upsampler: same: the 72-tensor latent upsampler without its VAE.
unstamped.qwen3.6-35b-a3b-fp8: NO v2 TOPOLOGY, and the reason is a MEASUREMENT, not an oversight. Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 carries 64196 tensors across 42 members; the bf16 release it is nominally a quantization of carries 1045 across 26. The fp8 release is not a requant of the bf16 packaging — it also splits the MoE experts — so it is a DIFFERENT topology, needing its own extraction and its own vllm rule. v1's `qwen3.6-35b-a3b.vllm-fp8@1` answered `satisfies` here on a 92-declaration pattern list, which is the vacuous admit v2 refuses to reproduce. Recorded, not papered over.
unstamped.sd15: the @1-era extraction reference: stable-diffusion-v1-5's UNet subfolder ALONE. A real sub-network and the v1 baseline's input, but no published checkpoint is it, and tensorfs#153 ruled a topology is the WHOLE published tree — so it stamps nothing. Kept banked because the v1-verdict regression replays against it.
unstamped.sdxl-inpainting: same: the inpainting UNet alone (fp32). The whole-tree reference is sdxl-inpainting-tree.
unstamped.sdxl-inpainting-bf16: same: the @1-era HOLE fixture, a lone re-typed UNet. The hole lives on at whole-tree scale as sdxl-inpainting-tree-bf16.
unstamped.wan22: the upstream Wan2.2 diffusers tree: F32 denoisers beside a BF16 text encoder. The fleet binds tensorhub's bf16 repack (wan22-hub) whose F32-VAE islands are wan22.diffusers@2's reference facts; against those the upstream mix satisfies no plain rule — F32 transformer under plain.bf16, BF16 text encoder under plain.f32. A mirror-ingest of the raw upstream tree stamps nothing until cast; the cast IS what the fleet serves.
